vo.text: Before this hackathon, we had idea and planning notes.
Everything you'll see was built this week.
Seven p.m.
Your disk is full.
You need one small app.
Ten tabs.
Every review disagrees.
One wants a subscription.
One wants full disk access.
Is it even safe?
Install four.
Delete three.
Or have AI build one, and maintain it forever.
Eleven forty-eight.
Still full.
Chances are, someone already built it.
pickfit finds it, and tells you what it actually tested.
Seven p.m., again.
This time, just say what you need.
pickfit matches it against software it has installed and tested itself.
Ranked by fit, not stars.
No ads.
Want to see it first?
This is pickfit using MangoDisk on a fresh macOS VM.
One chapter per feature it checked.
The hands are Muse Spark Open,
Meta's open-weight model.
Hand it to your agent.
It gets the exact steps that worked in the sandbox.
It warns you about known vulnerabilities first.
And it asks before it runs anything.
Scan.
Find the big ones.
Clear them.
Your evening is back.
Then your agent tells pickfit how it went.
You're not the only one looking for software.
So is your agent.
Ask it something it has no tool for.
pickfit finds a scanner that was tested on a Mac.
Your agent asks first, then runs it.
Or it gives itself a new skill:
a Project Gutenberg server, added with your okay, and used on the spot.
That ticket existed before you asked.
It started as one submission.
Muse Spark Open made the first cut in two seconds.
Muse Spark 1.3 read the README and kept the quotes.
Then, a fresh macOS VM.
Muse Spark 1.3 installed it,
Muse Spark Open clicked through all four features, and pickfit checked the results.
When it kept missing small checkboxes, we measured why, and taught it to zoom in and aim again.
Nine hundred sixty-three tools listed.
About six hundred fifty verified, at least through install.
The rest say so.
On the other end of the thread is the person who built it.
This week, pickfit went looking.
Next,
makers come to it:
submit from your agent in one call, and the same tests run.
And what agents report back will sharpen every match.
Ask through your agent, or on the web.
The rest of your evening is yours.
pickfit.
The right software, for the person who needs it.
